description: List invoices with number, status, line items, total, total_paid, amount due, due date and related job/contact. Returns {count, results}; count is the account total. JobNimbus: GET /v2/invoices.

from.description: Zero-based offset for pagination (default 0). Next page: from + size.

size.description: Records per page, 1-1000. Defaults to 25 here (the API's own default is 1000).

name: jobnimbus_list_invoices
title: List invoices
